```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1E2A4A;
    --navy-light:#2B3A61;
    --coral:#E8734A;
    --coral-light:#F2A184;
    --coral-tint:#FFF3EE;
    --paper:#F7F7F5;
    --ink:#232A3B;
    --muted:#767F94;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    background:#12182b;
    color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .deck{
    width:100%;
    max-width:980px;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .deck-logo{
    position:absolute; top:16px; right:20px; z-index:5;
    background:#fff; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:9px;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    display:flex; align-items:center;
  }
  .deck-logo img{height:32px; display:block;}
  .slide{
    position:absolute;
    top:0; right:0; bottom:0; left:0;
    padding:30px 48px;
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateX(24px);
    transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
    overflow:auto;
  }
  .slide::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:5px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coral) 0%, var(--coral-light) 100%);
  }
  .slide.title-slide::before{display:none;}
  .slide.active{display:flex; opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);}
  .kicker{
    font-size:14px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  h1{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:44px; font-weight:800; margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.12; letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:20px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 9px; color:var(--navy);}
  h3{font-size:12px; margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--navy); font-weight:700;}
  p.lede{font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.5;}
  p.note{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px;}
  p.tasktext{font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.45;}
  .dsbadge{display:inline-block; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:6px; padding:3px 10px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:7px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;}
  .dsbadge b{color:var(--coral);}

  .title-slide{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%); color:#fff; position:relative;}
  .title-slide::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-120px; width:420px; height:420px;
    border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,115,74,.16) 0%, rgba(232,115,74,0) 70%);
  }
  .title-slide h1{color:#fff; font-size:46px; font-weight:800;}
  .title-slide .accent{color:var(--coral-light);}
  .title-slide p.lede{color:#C7CCDA; font-size:15.5px;}
  .badge{margin-top:22px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; letter-spacing:.01em;}
  .badge .sub{display:block; font-weight:400; font-size:12px; color:#9AA3BC; margin-top:2px;}
  .title-slide .deck-logo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);}

  .callout{border-radius:10px; padding:11px 15px; margin:8px 0;}
  .callout.navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .callout.navy .tag{color:var(--coral-light); font-weight:700; font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:4px;}
  .callout.navy p{margin:0; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5;}
  .callout.def{background:var(--paper); border-left:4px solid var(--navy); font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}
  .callout.warn{background:var(--coral-tint); border-left:4px solid var(--coral); font-size:11px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}

  .bullets{list-style:none; margin:8px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .bullets li{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink); padding:5px 0 5px 22px; position:relative; line-height:1.4;}
  .bullets li::before{content:"•"; position:absolute; left:2px; color:var(--coral); font-size:16px; line-height:1;}

  .taskcard{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E2E2DE; border-left:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:8px; padding:12px 15px; margin:7px 0;}
  .taskcard .ttag{font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:5px;}
  .taskcard .ttext{font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink);}
  .taskcard.promptcard{border-left-color:var(--coral); background:var(--coral-tint);}
  .taskcard.promptcard .ttag{color:var(--coral);}

  .codewrap{position:relative; margin:6px 0;}
  .codebox{background:#1c2440; color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:8px; padding:9px 46px 9px 12px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; line-height:1.55; overflow-x:auto;}
  .codecopybtn{position:absolute; top:6px; right:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.10); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 9px; font-size:10px; cursor:pointer;}
  .codecopybtn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
  .codecopybtn.copied{background:var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral); color:#fff;}

  .cols2{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:6px;}
  .oscard{flex:1; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 13px;}

  .linkcard{display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 17px; transition:box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s;}
  .linkcard:hover{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08); border-color:var(--coral-light);}
  .linkcard h3{color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:3px; font-size:13px;}
  .linkcard .url{font-size:10px; color:var(--coral); font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace; margin-top:5px; word-break:break-all;}

  .errorbox{background:#2b1a20; color:#f3b4b4; border-left:4px solid var(--coral); border-radius:8px; padding:10px 13px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; line-height:1.55; margin-top:7px; white-space:pre-wrap;}
  .errorbox .taglabel{display:block; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--coral-light); margin-bottom:5px;}

  .reveal-panel.hidden ul{display:none;}
  .revealbtn{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 15px; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; margin-top:8px;}
  .revealbtn:hover{background:var(--navy-light);}

  .glossary{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px 20px; margin-top:10px;}
  .gitem{font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #EEECE7;}
  .gitem code{display:block; color:var(--navy); font-weight:700; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:2px; background:none; padding:0;}
  .gitem span{color:var(--muted);}

  .navbar{width:100%; max-width:980px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:14px; color:#C7CCDA; font-size:12.5px;}
  .navbar .btns{display:flex; gap:8px;}
  .navbtn{background:#1c2440; border:1px solid #333d5c; color:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 15px; font-size:12.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .navbtn:hover{background:#2b3660;}
  .navbtn:disabled{opacity:.35; cursor:default;}
  .progress{font-size:11.5px; color:#8b93ad;}
</style>

<div class="deck" id="deck">

  <div class="deck-logo"><img src="eppslogo.png" alt="UTD EPPS logo"></div>

  <div class="slide active title-slide">
    <div class="kicker">EPPS Math &amp; Coding Camp</div>
    <h1>Data<br><span class="accent">Visualization</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">Histograms, boxplots, and scatter plots in base R, then layered graphics with ggplot2.</p>
    <div class="badge">JP Adjadeh<span class="sub">EPPS, UT Dallas</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <img src="check_in_form.png" alt="Attendance check-in QR code" style="width:220px; height:220px; display:block; margin:auto;">
  </div>


  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before We Start</div>
    <h2>See the range of what's possible</h2>
    <p class="lede">Two galleries worth exploring — different chart types, different tools, different visual styles.</p>
    <div class="cols2">
      <a href="https://www.mckinsey.com/featured-insights/charts" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="linkcard">
        <h3>McKinsey — Charts of the Day</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:2px;">Business and policy data, visualized for a general audience.</p>
        <div class="url">mckinsey.com/featured-insights/charts</div>
      </a>
      <a href="https://observablehq.com/@d3/gallery" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="linkcard">
        <h3>Observable — D3 Gallery</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:2px;">Interactive, code-driven visualizations built with D3.js.</p>
        <div class="url">observablehq.com/@d3/gallery</div>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R</div>
    <h2>Key Functions</h2>
    <div class="glossary">
      <div class="gitem"><code>par()</code><span>Controls layout, margins, and colors</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>plot(), points(), lines()</code><span>Creates plots and adds points/lines</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>axis(), box()</code><span>Adds custom axes and borders</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>text(), mtext()</code><span>Adds labels in the plot or margins</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>hist()</code><span>Makes histograms</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>boxplot()</code><span>Compares distributions</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>barplot(), pie()</code><span>Bar charts and pie charts</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>abline(), legend()</code><span>Reference lines and legends</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Histogram</div>
    <h2>A histogram, with color</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>life_exp</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">hist() plots the distribution of a numeric column. col and border set the fill and outline.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:12px;">hist(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Histogram of Average Life Expectancy",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlab = "Average Life Expectancy",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;col = "lightblue", border = "grey")</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='hist(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy,
    main = "Histogram of Average Life Expectancy",
    xlab = "Average Life Expectancy",
    col = "lightblue", border = "grey")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Histogram, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — a histogram of Average_Life_Expectancy with color — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Histogram</div>
    <h2>Adding mean and median lines</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>life_exp</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">abline() draws a reference line over an existing plot. legend() labels what each color means. Remember na.rm = TRUE — this column has missing values.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:13px;">mean_le &lt;- mean(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)<br>median_le &lt;- median(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)<br><br>hist(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, col = "lightblue", border = "black")<br>abline(v = mean_le, col = "blue", lwd = 2)<br>abline(v = median_le, col = "red", lwd = 2)<br>legend("topleft", legend = c("Mean", "Median"), col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='mean_le <- mean(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)
median_le <- median(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)

hist(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, col = "lightblue", border = "black")
abline(v = mean_le, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(v = median_le, col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Mean", "Median"), col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Histogram + Lines, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — the same histogram with mean and median reference lines and a legend — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Boxplot</div>
    <h2>Comparing distributions by group</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>life_exp</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">boxplot() with formula syntax (numeric ~ category) compares a distribution across groups. col takes one color per box.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:12px;">boxplot(Average_Life_Expectancy ~ Gender, data = life_exp,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Boxplot of Life Expectancy by Gender",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlab = "Gender", ylab = "Average Life Expectancy",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;col = c("lightblue", "lightgreen"))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='boxplot(Average_Life_Expectancy ~ Gender, data = life_exp,
        main = "Boxplot of Life Expectancy by Gender",
        xlab = "Gender", ylab = "Average Life Expectancy",
        col = c("lightblue", "lightgreen"))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Boxplot, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — a boxplot of Average_Life_Expectancy by Gender, with one color per box — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Scatter Plot</div>
    <h2>Points colored by category</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>life_exp</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">pch sets the point shape (19 is a solid filled circle). ifelse() assigns a color conditionally, one value per row.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:13.5px;">plot(life_exp$Year, life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlab = "Year", ylab = "Average Life Expectancy",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Life Expectancy Over Time by Gender",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;pch = 19, col = ifelse(life_exp$Gender == "Male", "blue", "red"))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='plot(life_exp$Year, life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy,
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Average Life Expectancy",
     main = "Life Expectancy Over Time by Gender",
     pch = 19, col = ifelse(life_exp$Gender == "Male", "blue", "red"))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Scatter Plot, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — a scatter plot of Average_Life_Expectancy over Year, points colored by Gender — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Line Plot</div>
    <h2>Two lines, a legend, and an annotation</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>life_exp</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">subset() splits the data by group. lines() adds a second line to the same plot. range() sets axis limits wide enough for both. text() and abline() add the annotation.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:12px;">male_data &lt;- subset(life_exp, Gender == "Male")<br>female_data &lt;- subset(life_exp, Gender == "Female")<br><br>plot(male_data$Year, male_data$Average_Life_Expectancy, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlim = range(life_exp$Year),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ylim = range(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))<br>lines(female_data$Year, female_data$Average_Life_Expectancy, col = "red", lwd = 2)<br>legend("bottomright", legend = c("Male", "Female"), col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)<br>abline(v = 1918, col = "black", lty = 3)<br>text(1918, 75, "End of World War I")</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='male_data <- subset(life_exp, Gender == "Male")
female_data <- subset(life_exp, Gender == "Female")

plot(male_data$Year, male_data$Average_Life_Expectancy, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlim = range(life_exp$Year),
     ylim = range(life_exp$Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))
lines(female_data$Year, female_data$Average_Life_Expectancy, col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Male", "Female"), col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
abline(v = 1918, col = "black", lty = 3)
text(1918, 75, "End of World War I")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Line Plot, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — two life expectancy lines by Gender over Year, with a legend and a labeled reference line at 1918 — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Bar Chart</div>
    <h2>Counting records by category</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>air</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">table() counts how many rows fall into each category. barplot() turns those counts into bars.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:13.5px;">type_counts &lt;- table(air$Type_Name)<br><br>barplot(type_counts,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Number of Readings by Type",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlab = "Type", ylab = "Count",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;col = "steelblue")</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='type_counts <- table(air$Type_Name)

barplot(type_counts,
        main = "Number of Readings by Type",
        xlab = "Type", ylab = "Count",
        col = "steelblue")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Bar Chart, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — a vertical bar chart counting air readings by Type_Name — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Bar Chart</div>
    <h2>Same chart, horizontal</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>air</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">horiz = TRUE flips the bars sideways — useful when category labels are long. las = 1 keeps axis labels horizontal for readability.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:13.5px;">barplot(type_counts,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Number of Readings by Type",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;xlab = "Count", horiz = TRUE,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;col = "steelblue", las = 1)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='barplot(type_counts,
        main = "Number of Readings by Type",
        xlab = "Count", horiz = TRUE,
        col = "steelblue", las = 1)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Horizontal Bar Chart, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — the same bar chart of air readings by Type_Name, oriented horizontally — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Base R — Pie Chart</div>
    <h2>Showing a share of the whole</h2>
    <div class="dsbadge">Dataset: <b>ev</b></div>
    <p class="tasktext">table() counts each category again; pie() turns those counts into wedges sized by proportion.</p>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" style="font-size:13.5px;">ev_type_counts &lt;- table(ev$`Electric Vehicle Type`)<br><br>pie(ev_type_counts,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;main = "Share of Vehicles by Type",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;col = c("cornflowerblue", "coral"))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='ev_type_counts <- table(ev$`Electric Vehicle Type`)

pie(ev_type_counts,
    main = "Share of Vehicles by Type",
    col = c("cornflowerblue", "coral"))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Pie Chart, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now prompt it</h2>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Write your own AI prompt to reproduce this chart — a pie chart showing the share of ev by `Electric Vehicle Type` — in base R. Compare what the AI gives you to the example above.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

    <h2>The choice AI can't make</h2>
    <div class="callout warn">AI can generate a working plot() call in one pass. It will not tell you whether a line chart, bar chart, or boxplot is the right choice for what you're trying to show — that depends on the shape of your data and the question you're asking.</div>

    <h2>Key Components</h2>
    <div class="glossary">
      <div class="gitem"><code>ggplot(data, aes())</code><span>The base canvas and variable mapping</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>geom_point()</code><span>Adds points — a scatterplot layer</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>geom_smooth()</code><span>Adds a fitted trend line</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>geom_bar(), geom_boxplot()</code><span>Bar charts and boxplots as layers</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>geom_histogram()</code><span>Histograms as a layer</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>facet_wrap()</code><span>Splits into panels by a category</span></div>
      <div class="gitem"><code>labs(), theme_minimal()</code><span>Labels and a clean, minimal look</span></div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Layers stack with +, in order.</p>
  </div>

<div class="navbar">
  <div class="progress" id="progress">1 / 39</div>
  <div class="btns">
    <button class="navbtn" id="prevBtn" onclick="go(-1)">Prev</button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="nextBtn" onclick="go(1)">Next</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  let current = 0;

  function render(){
    slides.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle('active', i === current));
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = current === 0;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = current === slides.length - 1;
    document.getElementById('progress').textContent = (current+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
  }

  function go(delta){
    const next = current + delta;
    if(next >= 0 && next < slides.length){ current = next; render(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'PageDown' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); go(1); }
    if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') { e.preventDefault(); go(-1); }
  });

  function showReveal(id){
    document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function copyCode(btn){
    const raw = btn.getAttribute('data-copy').replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(raw).then(() => {
      const original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = original; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1400);
    });
  }

  function sizeDeck(){
    const deck = document.getElementById('deck');
    deck.style.height = (deck.offsetWidth * 9 / 16) + 'px';
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', sizeDeck);
  sizeDeck();

  render();
</script>
```
